description:
Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.

Start from a prompt, a script, a document, or a link. We build a multi-scene video draft using your workspace's brand kits or one our curated Styles. Choose your Style or brand kit in the chat, open the draft in Synthesia to edit, or just generate and watch the video directly in the chat.

Already have the source material somewhere else? Pull it from the tools you're connected to and hand it straight to us — no copy-paste, no rebuilding.

You can ask Synthesia to:

"Make a video explaining our new expense policy."
"Turn this brief into a two-minute video for new starters."
"Take the notes from our product spec and make an internal launch video."
"Pull this quarter's numbers and make a 90-second update for the team."
"Find the onboarding video we published last quarter."
"Summarize what shipped this week and turn it into a video for the sales team."
"Show me my drafts."

Requirements: a paid Synthesia account. Connect once and we'll use your existing brand settings and workspace permissions — you'll only ever see videos you already have access to in Synthesia.

Want to go hands-on? Every draft or generated video can be opened in Synthesia's full editor for editing and polish.

This plugin is currently in beta and features may be added or removed in the future, and there may be bugs. Please report any bugs, feedback, or issues you experience at https://synthesiacreate.typeform.com/mcp-beta and/or support@synthesia.io
